channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Quincy Acy | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Quincy Acy from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kenny Atkinson on Quincy Acy
item.description:
Brian Lewis:Atkinson on Acy:

“(I’ve liked) his energy, toughness, he’s got good athleticism about him, aggressiveness... He's an improved shooter”

Kenny Atkinson on Quincy Acy, Jan 19, 2017. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Quincy Acy
item.description:
Earl K Sneed:Rick Carlisle on Quincy Acy:

“We have some physical guys, but every team wants to have a bunch of ass-kickers. He's an ass-kicker.”

Rick Carlisle on Quincy Acy, Oct 2, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Quincy Acy
item.description:
Chris Herring:Melo, on having Acy's back:

“That's my teammate. That's my man, that's my guy. ... I wanted to get him away from [the situation].”

Carmelo Anthony on Quincy Acy, Dec 25, 2014. Source: Twitter @HerringWSJ.

item.title: John Wall on Quincy Acy
item.description:
Jorge Castillo:Wall on whether Acy threw a punch:

“I don’t know. I ducked. I know when I push somebody you ain’t about to stand there straight up.”

John Wall on Quincy Acy, Dec 25, 2014. Source: Twitter @jorgeccastillo.

item.title: Paul Pierce on John Wall, Quincy Acy
item.description:
Andrew Keh:Paul Pierce on Wall versus Acy:

“Like we always say, if you don't like physicality then go play golf.”

Paul Pierce on John Wall, Quincy Acy, Dec 25, 2014. Source: Twitter @andrewkeh.
